title: The iPhone Duo Just Passed 20,000 in Our Fold-a-Phone Testing Machine. Can It Beat the Galaxy Z Fold 8? - CNET
description: We're folding Apple's iPhone Duo 900 times an hour to test how its hinge will last.

title: Palestinian families displaced as Israeli forces demolish Hebron homes, local officials say - BBC
description: The crackdown follows the killing of two Israeli soldiers by two Palestinian gunmen on Friday - and comes just days ahead of Israel's election.

title: U.K. police say they received letter with claims against Meghan's father, wasn't shared with other law enforcement - CBS News
description: On Friday, it was reported that Meghan's father, Thomas Markle, is under investigation by authorities in the Philippines for alleged possession of child sexual abuse materials.

title: Six Flags adding seat belts to some rollercoasters following death - BBC
description: The CEO of the amusement park chain said the company is evaluating its safety procedures at all of its 34 locations, including adding seat belts to some rides.

title: Man arrested after fire at Hitler's mountaintop Eagle's Nest retreat - BBC
description: Some 200 emergency personnel were deployed to fight the blaze at the Nazi dictator's Alpine residence in Germany.
